label: Google TV Streamer (4K) with Thread border router
description: Google TV Streamer (4K) is Google's set-top box with Google TV, Matter and a built-in Thread border router for the home. Unlike the older Chromecast dongles it has a genuine wired option: one 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet port beside 802.11ac Wi-Fi on 2.4/5 GHz and Bluetooth 5.1, and its USB-C port is power/data rather than networking.
